description: Capability for the main window: app-data file access, save/open dialogs, shutdown, and reference-autofill HTTP endpoints. `process:allow-exit` and `core:window:allow-hide` back the close button — neither is in a default set, and without them the close path is denied and silently does nothing. The wildcard http(s) scopes exist because URL autofill scrapes user-pasted pages (http kept for legacy academic sites); the CrossRef/OpenLibrary entries document the primary endpoints.
